business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Wholesale Trade of Aged Scotch and Bordeaux Wines

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic system with administrative-law overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Accord entre le Gouvernement de la République française et le Gouvernement de la République populaire de Chine sur l'encouragement et la protection réciproques des investissements (France-China BIT, signed 30 May 1984, entered into force 19 March 1985)

Convention entre la France et la Chine en vue d'éviter les doubles impositions et de prévenir l'évasion et la fraude fiscales en matière d'impôts sur le revenu et sur la fortune (France-China DTAA, signed 30 November 1984, as amended by Protocol of 2 November 2013)
EU-China Agreement on Cooperation on, and Protection of, Geographical Indications (in force 1 March 2021; protects designated French wines and spirits)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59-1; UBO register provisions at Articles L.561-45 et seq.; Code de commerce Articles L.123-1 to L.123-33-2 and R.123-220/R.123-231; Décret n°2016-1638 du 30 novembre 2016 (fichier des bénéficiaires effectifs).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each shareholder and manager (gérant) of the French SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary, consulate, or issuing authority in the shareholder's/manager's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (74 States party to the 1961 Hague Convention) or French Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions; certified French translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months) for each individual shareholder and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company, financial institution, or municipal registry in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization where required, with certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney (procuration) appointing the French incorporation agent or attorney to execute the SARL formation deed and registration filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified French translation; original notarized signature page required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / registration extract and beneficial ownership proof of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, completed within 3 months; certified French translation required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under CMF Articles L.561-5 and L.561-10; PEP status must be screened using domestic and international databases covering TRACFIN guidance, FATF Recommendations, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and OFAC/SDN for any USD Swift-wire rails; enhanced verification is required for non-resident shareholders and for bonded-trade counterparties; any suspicious transaction report must be filed with TRACFIN under CMF Article L.561-15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises / INPI); name-availability search via data.inpi.fr and the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official RCS record requires a Latin-script corporate name; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated. The name may be in any language but must not be contrary to public policy and must enable a clear French description to be filed. Accents and French typographic conventions are permitted; purely numerical names or names reproducing a registered mark without consent may be refused.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / bank (requires authorization from ACPR and use of the legal status of a credit institution)
Mutuelle (requires approval as a mutual insurance society)
Notaire / Avocat / Architecte / Ingénieur / Expert-comptable (regulated professions, require ordinal registration)
France / République / National / Officiel (if used in a way implying public or state endorsement)
Chambre de commerce / Bourse / Caisse des Dépôts (institutionally protected denominations)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is refused by the RCS/greffe, the applicant may (1) re-file through formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr with an amended name after a fresh RNE search, or (2) file an administrative appeal before the presiding judge of the competent Tribunal judiciaire or Tribunal de commerce within 15 days of receipt of the refusal, under Code de commerce Article R.123-31, producing the contested name, the search report, and evidence of distinctiveness. A change of name requires a new resolution and an amended filing; there is no ministerial name-consent route for an ordinary SARL.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible as a domiciliation arrangement for the SARL's seat under Code de commerce Article L.123-11-2, but inadequate alone for the bonded wine/spirits model; the operator must maintain or contract a French Customs-approved bonded warehouse (entrepôt sous douane / entrepôt fiscal) and hold excise authorization under Code général des impôts Article 302 B and Customs Code Articles 63 et seq. A virtual office will not satisfy DGDDI physical-stock audit requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (80-90%), because the DGDDI (Customs and Indirect Duties Administration) conducts unannounced premium-wine and spirits stocktake inspections, and DGCCRF verifies commercial integrity at bonded premises; frequency increases when excise-duty suspension and intra-EU arrivals are in use.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fixed fee for new company registration; INPI data consultation and preemption tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of legal incorporation notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed legal gazette (JAL) designated by the company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated market tariff based on number of lines and department

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation contract with a licensed domiciliation provider for 12 months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for commercial domiciliation in a top-tier French business zone

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague apostille, and certified French translation of passport, address proof, and power of attorney bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary of origin, competent apostille authority, court-approved translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory/notarial tariff plus prevailing translation market rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration preparation and incorporation legal drafting fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French business law firm (avocat) or registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market professional fee for SARL drafting and UBO compliance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Manager (gérant) criminal record verification (Bulletin n°3) and administrative compliance dossier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French judicial public service (Caserne de Justice / greffe) and processing agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee for bulletin n°3 issuance plus service charge

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (Constitution, capital, management of a Société à Responsabilité Limitée) and Articles R.123-1 et seq. (Répertoire des Entreprises et des Établissements)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; registration via the INPI 'Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises'
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and the single M0 form (Déclaration de création d'une personne morale) filed through the online national business formalities portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a French SARL. The capital is freely fixed in the articles of association; any cash contribution must be fully paid up and deposited on an escrow-type blocked account with a French bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until the RCS certificate is issued, evidenced by an attestation de dépôt de fonds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Pro Forma First Board Resolution of the sole manager of FR_SARL, acting pursuant to the Articles of Association: 1) The share capital, composed of [X] ordinary shares subscribed and fully paid by each shareholder, is hereby approved and recorded; 2) The registered office is fixed at [legal address], Paris, France; 3) The sole manager is appointed lawful representative with sole signature authority to open bank mandates, sign commercial contracts and file all customs and excise declarations; 4) The bank certificate proving deposit of the cash contributions is acknowledged; 5) The manager is instructed to file the formation dossiers with the RCS and DGDDI without delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Execute the Articles of Association and Legal Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary or qualified legal counsel, followed by publication of the avis de constitution in a Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the fully customized Statuts complying with Articles L.223-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code, including corporate form, duration, share capital breakdown, minority rights, management authority, and dispute resolution. All shareholders sign the Statuts (private deed or notarized if a notary is chosen). Engage a JAL in the department of the registered office to publish the legal notice of constitution containing the corporate name, length, registered office, capital, and manager's identity. Retain the 'certificat de publication' produced by the JAL.
required_dossiers: Draft of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
Power of attorney if a representative signs for a shareholder
Proof of identity for all shareholders (passport or national ID)
Legal publication certificate from the Journal d'Annonces Légales
Cover letter specifying the chosen registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requests corrections, amend the draft notice and republish the same day; if shareholder identification is insufficient, provide notarized copies within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Share Capital and Obtain Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary share capital deposit account in the company's name and transfer the total cash contribution to be released only upon presentation of the RCS certificate (Kbis). The bank issues a French-language certificate attesting the deposit, identifying the company name, parliamentary account number, deposit amounts and date, and the blocked nature of the funds.
required_dossiers: Bank deposit documentation (attestation de dépôt de fonds)
List of subscribers with contribution amounts
Signed bank account opening forms for the temporary capital block account
Corporate name reservation slip (optional but recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the attestation due to incomplete KYC, promptly supply updated identity documents and a beneficial ownership declaration; if the bank delays beyond 4 days, select a second regulated financial institution and re-submit the deposit file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Incorporation Dossier with the National Business Formalities Portal (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log onto the official 'Guichet unique en ligne' and complete the M0 merging form cover central information of the company and its natural person legal representatives, including the beneficial owners. Upload the executed Statuts, the bank certificate, the JAL publication certificate, a proof of postal address for the registered office, and the list of managers accepting their functions. Pay the relevant fee online. Submit the electronic dossier; the Registry performs a legal consistency check before transcribing the company into the RCS.
required_dossiers: Completed M0 form (fiabilisation des données)
Scanned fully executed and dated Articles of Association
Bank certificate of capital deposit
JAL publication certificate
Declaration of beneficial ownership (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs)
Personal identification and criminal record waiver for the manager
Proof of address of the registered office (lease or ownership title)
Receipt of online fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the INPI or the Registry issues a 'case à corriger' notice, consult the procedural dashboard, correct the flagged field within 15 days, and re-submit the corrected data. If the submission is wholly refused, file a fresh M0 after amending the underlying Statuts and re-publish if necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive the RCS Certificate (Kbis) and Open Final Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the registration is accepted, the Greffe issues the
required_dossiers: Confirmation of registration from INPI
Article completed above
Power of attorney for physical pick-up of Kbis (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a duplicate Kbis by email or phone if the original is delayed; verify the legal entity data on the RCS online extract and dispute any errors via an administrative rectification request to the Greffe.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Secure Excise Bonded Warehouse Authorisation and Industrial Operating Licenses
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) and local fire/prevention authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the Kbis, submit a separate application to the local DGDDI office requesting approval as an entrepositaire agréé (authorized warehousekeeper) for wine and spirits. Provide the valuation of the industrial and storage premises, a schematic of the tax warehouse, inventory procedures, and a customs bond where spirituous beverages exceed fiscal guarantees thresholds. Simultaneously file an ICPE declaration (e.g. 'déclaration d'installation classée') for storage of alcohol if the aggregate capacity exceeds regulatory thresholds, and apply for the fire safety and occupancy clearance from the municipality.
required_dossiers: RCS Kbis extract
DGDDI application form for entrepositaire agréé
Description of the warehouse and sales facility
Evidence of title or lease for the business premises
Inventory management plan and stock accounting system
Bond or bank guarantee issued for excise purposes (where required)
Fire safety certificate and structural feasibility note
ICPE preliminary dossier (declaration or registration)
Civil liability and inventory insurance certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGDDI requests additional evidence, complete the technical questionnaire and schedule an on-site inspection within 20 days. If classified installation procedures require an enquiry, cooperate with the local inspection of the DREAL and resolve any dissatisfaction note before re-lodging the authorization request.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) in coordination with the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) and the Municipality for activity permits
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'exploitation d'un entrepôt fiscal (approved bonded warehouse operator for wines and spirits) plus the Déclaration d'activité for wholesale trade of alcohol granted by the local municipality

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) and the French Agency for Ecological Transition (ADEME) for waste registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA remains triggered only where the storage capacity of alcohol is 500 m³ or more (ICPE submission under 'Enregistrement' – regime E). For lower thresholds, a simple 'Déclaration' ICPE procedure applies; small distributed warehouses without aggregation might be exempt, but a case-by-case preliminary screening under Article R122-2 of the French Environmental Code is always recommended.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: compliance with the local discharge authorization and the Water Decree (Articles L214-1 et seq.) for storm-water and vinification effluent discharge, BOD5 < 100 mg/L; VOC emissions: compliance with Directive 2010/75/EU / French decree Stellen 'Arrêté du 2 mai 2002' concerning VOC solvent management; waste handling: submit annual waste declarations (ADEME/TOU) and ensure disposal of bottles, packaging, and sludge via registered collectors only.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification delivered by the local emergency services after inspection of the warehouse and dispatch area (areas with alcohol subject to ATEX zoning checks); structural load inspection of storage racks by an approved architectural/engineering bureau; occupational health and safety clearance issued by the Labour Inspectorate (Inspection du travail) including emergency evacuation plans, training records and prevention of manual handling risks.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities establishing a French SARL must register with the DGFiP to obtain SIREN/SIRET and VAT identification number (TVA intracommunautaire). Bonded warehouse operations for wine and spirits require prior customs authorization (agrément douanier) from the Douane before tax registration and excise licensing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Default entity-level taxation applies under French corporate income tax rules; limited hybrid mismatch provisions under ATAD Directive.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance via PEP platform; electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) required for B2B transactions above 25,000 EUR threshold; digital fiscal stamps mandatory for bonded warehouse transactions and clearances.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods exported outside the EU or qualifying intra-EU supplies under reverse charge. For bonded warehouse operations, zero-rating granted upon proof of actual export from the warehouse.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsubstantiated zero-rating claims result in penalties of 40-80% of evaded VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback applies with potential criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, within the Eurosystem and under the monetary policy framework of the European Central Bank. French customs and tax authorities, including the Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI) and the Direction générale des finances publiques (DGFiP), administer relevant trade, excise, and tax requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies EU rules on free movement of capital and payments and has no general exchange-control approval requirement for ordinary commercial or capital transfers. The euro is freely convertible. Cross-border transfers remain subject to bank AML, sanctions, source-of-funds, tax, and transaction-purpose checks. Profit distributions to non-resident shareholders are generally permitted after applicable corporate-law approvals and French withholding-tax, treaty, and reporting analysis; dividend payments are not automatically tax-free. Interest, royalties, service fees, and intercompany payments require evidence of genuine transactions, transfer-pricing support where applicable, and withholding-tax review. Banks may request contracts, invoices, customs and excise records, accounts, and beneficial-owner information before processing payments.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio for foreign-currency export receipts. No general deadline requires export receipts to be converted into euros. The company must retain adequate accounting and transaction records, comply with applicable customs, VAT, excise, and statistical reporting obligations, and respond to bank or authority requests. Reporting obligations may apply to particular cross-border transactions or payment-service providers; confirm applicability with the bank and French advisers for the transaction profile.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital deposit account before registration, followed by a euro operational account and, subject to approval, foreign-currency accounts
Capital deposit account before registration, followed by a euro operational account and, subject to approval, foreign-currency accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and the relevant regional Crédit Agricole institution
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital deposit account before registration, followed by a euro operational account and, subject to approval, foreign-currency accounts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for routine euro collections and payments, subject to the provider's French or EEA authorization, permitted services, risk appetite, and account terms. An electronic-money account is not a substitute for a French bank account where a bank account or capital-deposit certificate is required for incorporation. Offshore or non-EEA digital EMIs may face correspondent-bank, safeguarding, sanctions, and onboarding limitations and may not support bonded-trade documentation, commercial letters of credit, or complex foreign-currency services. Verify the provider's regulatory status and permitted cross-border services before use.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no general French statutory requirement that every director appear physically for corporate account opening. Banks determine their own onboarding procedures and may require in-person attendance, video identification, certified documents, or a local representative, particularly for non-resident directors, complex ownership, or enhanced-risk alcohol trade. Remote opening may be available but is not guaranteed. A SARL ordinarily needs a capital-deposit certificate for registration when capital is deposited in cash; the bank may require formation documents and identity checks before accepting the deposit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident or layered ownership, nominee arrangements, or difficulty identifying the ultimate beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current corporate registry extracts and constitutional documents for each ownership layer; certified ownership chart through natural-person beneficial owners; passports and proof of residential address; beneficial-owner register information; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence; and board or shareholder authorizations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear capital funding, third-party deposits, transfers from unrelated entities, or funds originating in a higher-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital subscription and shareholder resolutions; bank statements tracing funds to the originating account and beneficial owner; audited financial statements, tax returns, sale or dividend records supporting source of funds; loan agreements where relevant; and an explanation of the commercial rationale and payment chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Alcohol, bonded-warehouse, excise, or customs exposure without demonstrated licensing, tax controls, or traceable inventory movements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Relevant French registrations and authorizations, including applicable excise and customs registrations; warehouse and logistics agreements; evidence of any required excise-suspension or movement-system arrangements; supplier and customer contracts; invoices; product and origin records; customs declarations; inventory reconciliation; and documented procedures for VAT, excise, and bonded transfers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value or unusual payments, cash-intensive activity, transactions inconsistent with the stated wholesale model, or payments involving sanctioned parties or restricted destinations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction-specific purchase orders, invoices, transport and delivery documents, customs and excise records, counterparty due diligence, sanctions-screening results, payment instructions, and a reconciliation linking each payment to the underlying shipment and accounting entry. Maintain a written policy prohibiting unlawful cash payments and transactions with prohibited parties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Material differences between the stated business activity, expected turnover, transaction geographies, account flows, and public or corporate records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan and cash-flow forecast; current management accounts; tax and VAT filings where available; supplier and customer profile; expected currency and jurisdiction matrix; warehouse and shipping arrangements; and a written explanation of seasonal, inventory-financing, or exceptional transactions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Fund the SARL from an account held by the shareholder or another documented, legally authorized funding source. Before incorporation, coordinate the capital deposit with the selected bank or other eligible depositary and obtain the capital-deposit certificate for registration. After registration, transfer operating funds to the SARL's corporate account, using SEPA Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments and SWIFT for non-SEPA or other-currency transfers. Use accurate payment references identifying the capital contribution, shareholder, and company; do not use an invented or generic regulatory purpose code. Provide subscription documents, shareholder resolutions, bank-origin evidence, and source-of-funds documentation. Record any shareholder loan separately from equity and document its terms. Banks may make compliance inquiries or delay or reject transfers pending review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer where available for eligible euro payments; use SWIFT customer credit transfers, commonly instructed as MT103-format messages, for other cross-border payments. For larger or higher-risk shipments, a documentary commercial letter of credit, documentary collection, or bank guarantee may be considered subject to bank approval and underlying trade documents. Reconcile each payment to the purchase contract, invoice, beneficiary, shipment, customs declaration, and applicable excise or bonded-warehouse records. Confirm beneficiary-account details independently, allocate bank charges expressly, and screen counterparties and banks for sanctions and payment restrictions. Use accurate payment narratives and retain records for accounting, VAT, customs, excise, and AML review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward exchange contracts for documented commercial exposures, subject to bank suitability, credit, and documentation requirements.
Foreign-exchange swaps for short-term liquidity or settlement-date management, subject to bank approval and documented exposure.
Currency options where offered by an authorized provider and proportionate to the company's documented commercial exposure and risk-management policy.

Non-deliverable forwards only where the relevant currency, counterparty, product, and transaction are legally permitted and the company has a genuine underlying exposure; these are not a substitute for compliance with applicable market and reporting rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dépôt des comptes annuels: approved annual financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, notes) together with the shareholders' profit-appropriation decision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Infogreffe electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval within 6 months of financial year end; electronic deposit within the following month, i.e. maximum 7 months after closing (31 July for a 31 December year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal notice followed by court injunction carrying daily astreinte of EUR 50–150; gérant exposed to criminal fine up to EUR 6,000; persistent default triggers judicial strike-off or compulsory dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Liasse fiscale: annual corporate income tax (IS) return, form n° 2065 with accounting schedules n° 2050–2059 and tax allocation form n° 2257
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques) via EDI-TDFC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3 May for a 31 December year end; otherwise within 3 months of closing (4 months if a statutory auditor has been appointed)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% automatic late-filing penalty; 40% if tax remains unpaid 30 days after first demand; 80–100% for concealed activity; monthly late interest at 0.2%; enforced via avis de mise en recouvrement and attachment measures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Déclaration de concordance des données: annual verification of the accuracy of RCS particulars (corporate name, legal form, capital, registered office, gérant, associates and UBO details) with correction of any changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) via Infogreffe annual verification procedure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year, benchmarked on the anniversary of RCS registration; changes arising during the year must be filed within 30 days of occurrence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 4th-class contravention, fine up to EUR 750; possibility of registry-initiated rectification; repeated failure constitutes a ground for administrative strike-off of the registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO beneficial-owner statement: confirmation of registered beneficial owners within the annual RCS verification and mandatory amendment on any shareholding or control change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Infogreffe UBO amendment formalities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Amendment within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership; annual confirmation embedded in the RCS data-consistency cycle (no standalone annual UBO form under French procedure)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or knowingly omitted UBO statement: up to 6 months' imprisonment and EUR 7,500 fine per responsible officer; Greffe refuses Kbis issuance and annual-accounts deposit until regularised; strike-off risk on persistent non-compliance

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% on the first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs; additional deductions for R&D, accelerated depreciation, and sector-specific incentives

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Déclaration de résultat (Form 1200 or equivalent via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., 30 June for calendar year ending 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for domestic French SARL; foreign owners report French-source income separately

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit after adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjustments for permanent establishments if applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 0.5% of tax due per month (maximum 5%) plus interest charges and possible criminal sanctions for willful non-compliance

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% (reduced to 0% under most double tax treaties)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from home jurisdiction, submit relevant treaty form (e.g., Formulaire 5000 or equivalent) to French tax authorities for reduced rate application
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory rate, reduced to 5-10% under treaties (e.g., 5% for copyright royalties); Interest: 25% statutory, reduced to 0% under most treaties if beneficial ownership met

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million annual turnover for Local File; €250 million for Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations apply to entities without sufficient economic presence in France, including pure holding companies and IP holding structures; requires core income generating activities and adequate employees and premises in France

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or understatement of taxable income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 80% of the evaded tax amount
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal criminal liability, imprisonment, and fines; corporate veil may be pierced in cases of abuse

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining a French entity without real business activities or substance in France
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Nullity of the entity acts, fines up to €75,000 per infraction, and potential criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for directors who knowingly participated in the setup or operation of the shell entity

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Entering into related-party transactions without arm's length pricing or adequate documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties of 5% to 80% of the tax adjustment, plus interest and potential criminal liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for tax deficiencies arising from non-compliant TP policies

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold or Report Cross-Border Payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-application of withholding tax on dividends, royalties, or interest paid to foreign entities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding tax due plus penalties of 10% to 80% of the unpaid tax and possible imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for directors failing to comply with withholding obligations
